paired_loading.sequence: Wire and inspect both empty carriers in the fixed 5 mm gap; load companion using the paired fixture, fit rear tray and temporary broad-pad clamps, lift and turn onto tray-bearing cradle, load primary, remove clamps while supported, dress protected harness and fit front shell/closure screws. Qualify first with surrogates.

The assumed 3 mm axial/20 degree cell insertion path is not a manufacturer specification.
Holder insertion/removal force, solder load path, clamp pressure, printed strength/creep, insulation and actual wire restraint need qualification.
One-piece spacer/catches require a slicer/support review; no support-free print claim.

companion_support_relief.opposite_face: B.Cu permits covered tracks only inside the band; no vias, pads, tails, exposed copper or copper pours
companion_support_relief.retained_supports: Corner posts, edge frame and outward F.Cu support retained; primary-facing spacer surface unchanged
companion_support_relief.insulation: Covered traces are recessed from the spacer; the separate insulating barrier remains. Solder mask is not the sole insulation.

primary_wire_tail_clearance.reason: Actual protected-harness and thermistor through-hole pad rows occupy the former primary upper spacer crossbar.
primary_wire_tail_clearance.preserved_support: All four corner posts and the outer perimeter frame remain; the primary upper crossbar contributes no additional contact band.
primary_wire_tail_clearance.tail_model: Conservative cylinders use each complete pad diameter across the maximum protrusion; all twelve anchors match the fixed electrical placement.
primary_wire_tail_clearance.limit: Nominal geometric clearance only. PCB/print tolerance, solder inspection, dielectric integrity and changed primary support loads require qualification.

protected_harness.retention: Two cable ties on integral cassette lid bars; qualification pending
protected_harness.internal_termination: Actual carrier pads now placed; final internal wire fan and strain retention remain qualification/design work

adjustable_buttons.setting: First electrical closure at positive stop; verify release, jam locking and repeated operation. No maximum overtravel is assumed.
adjustable_buttons.released_state: No intended preload; switch return must overcome guide friction. Cap can float within positive free gap.

motor_inline.retention: Two ties to raised cassette tray; cable male ear variant and pull/bend qualification open

limits: Named nominal static intersections plus conservative continuous service envelopes are checked; no tolerance or structural analysis.
Service drive/controller tests expand closed-cassette bounds through the 2.5 mm rise and 72 mm forward removal, including boards/cells, lid and inline tray/housing. Cable manipulation is excluded.

Cleat/backplate engagement uses 12 sampled actual rear-tray positions, not a continuous pocket sweep. The central washer pocket covers a continuous head sweep combining +/-2 mm wall-slot adjustment and 2.5 mm rise.
Integral holder end combs are capture stops with an independent gap, not preload or a verified solder-force bypass. Actual rim fit and controlled insertion-fixture use remain unqualified.

Paired-loading backing uses the existing reserved lands. Temporary catches, shell approach and tool corridors are geometric candidates; practical catch-release method and actual insertion/retention remain unfinished.
The protected pigtail parking is space-only; it does not complete the internal harness or prove strain-free loaded handling.
The companion spacer relief permits only covered B.Cu tracks; remaining section and barrier clearance are geometric checks, not dielectric, abrasion or structural qualification.

Primary upper crossbar is removed while corner posts/perimeter remain. Twelve actual wire/NTC pad anchors use full-pad-diameter 1.5 mm protrusion cylinders; 0.5 mm nominal barrier gap does not establish tolerance, dielectric or load acceptance.
The motor rear cable allocation is excluded from the wire/drive test because the wire intentionally enters it.
The cassette/contents test excludes intended PCB face seating planes with 0.02 mm contact bands.
The cassette/backplate test excludes the intended Z3 seating plane with a 0.02 mm contact band.
Controller-key interference checks the PCB interior, excluding its intended face-contact planes by 0.01 mm each.
The motor still carries radial load; its +7 mm shaft-offset fit and guard are provisional.
The 71 mm version requires inspected holder tail-and-fillet protrusion <=1.5 mm; untrimmed retained case not implemented.
Carrier and controller volumes are allocations, not actual routed board geometry.
Controller connector envelope and relaxed pigtail route are modeled; actual harness, latch/finger access and cable manipulation remain unqualified.
Protected carrier pads and controller ports are placed; internal pack wire fan, exact inline motor cable variant, signal retention and home-sensor mount are unfinished.
Button test samples nominal near-stop geometry, not a continuous tolerance sweep; actuation margin, return friction and locking require qualification.
Wall anchors, electrical insulation, cell-holder polarity/current/fastening, switch actuation, thermal and printed strength need qualification.
